import numpy as np
F=np.load('feats.npz'); y=F['y']
C9=F['C9'].astype(np.float64); M9=F['M9'].astype(np.float64); M0=F['M0'].astype(np.float64)
S=np.array([654,529,216,175,145,159,531,517])
# joint ridge
Xs=[]; mus=[]; sds=[]
for X in [C9,M9,M0]:
    m=X.mean(0); s=X.std(0)+1e-6; mus.append(m); sds.append(s); Xs.append((X-m)/s)
Z=np.concatenate(Xs,1); Y=np.eye(8)[y]-1/8
Zc=Z-Z.mean(0)
lam=1000
a=np.linalg.solve(Zc@Zc.T+lam*np.eye(len(Z)),Y-Y.mean(0)); Wt=Zc.T@a
W0=Wt[1536:]                      # on stdz M0
A0=(W0/sds[2][:,None]).T          # [8,768] on raw M0
b0=-(mus[2]/sds[2])@W0            # makes stash zero-mean
st=M0@A0.T+b0
print('stash std per class', np.round(st.std(0),3), 'mean', np.round(st.mean(0),4))
print('stash-only acc (in-sample)', (st.argmax(1)==y).mean())
full=Z@Wt+ (Y.mean(0)-Z.mean(0)@Wt); print('joint in-sample acc',(full.argmax(1)==y).mean())
# head-0 value dims to sacrifice
L='bert.encoder.layer.0.'
Wv=base(L+'attention.self.value.weight').astype(np.float64); bv=base(L+'attention.self.value.bias').astype(np.float64)
Wo=base(L+'attention.output.dense.weight').astype(np.float64)
v=M0@Wv[:64].T+bv[:64]            # [n,64] uniform-head values
cost=v.var(0)*np.linalg.norm(Wo[:,:64],axis=0)**2
J=np.argsort(cost)[:8]; print('J',J,'cost',np.round(cost[J],4),'median',np.round(np.median(cost),4))
# how big is head-0's output in stash dims originally / CLS embedding at stash dims
np.savez('stash_cfg.npz',S=S,J=J,A0=A0,b0=b0,vmean=v.mean(0))
